title: Keto Doner Wrap
description: A low-carb twist on the classic doner kebab, wrapped in a comforting and crunchy lettuce leaf.

ingredients.name: Doner meat
ingredients.notes: Lean beef or lamb, thinly sliced

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cook the doner meat for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the lettuce leaf by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the mashed avocado on the lettuce leaf, followed by the cooked doner meat.
Add the sliced tomato, red onion, and cucumber on top of the meat.
Sprinkle with chilli flakes and feta cheese if using.
